exact_statement: For every r>=1,k>=2 on the uniform cube, F=(product of r disjoint k-bit point-defect signs)*(parity on 2^r fresh indexed coordinates) admits an all-essential partial singleton tree querying the first bit of each defect and then the parity coordinate indexed by those r outcomes. With transcript Pi, output Y, coherent root Fourier set S0, actual ambient terminal Fourier set W=S0\Q(Pi), d=2^(1-k) and j_k=h2(v/2)-h2(v)/2 for v=4*2^(-(k-1))*(1-2^(-(k-1))), its removed influence is R=1+rd, I(Y;Pi)=0, I(S0;Pi)=r*j_k, I(W;Pi)=r, Gamma_W=H(Pi|Y)-H(Pi|W)=r, and I(W;Pi|S0)=H(Q|S0)=r*(1-j_k). Terminal I is 2^r-1+r*(k-1)*d, terminal expected Fourier entropy is r*H(h_(k-1))/2, and root entropy is r*H(h_k). For k=2r+2 the conversion Gamma_W/2 divided by R diverges; r=4,k=10 certifies Gamma_W/2=2>R/ln2 with R=129/128. All quantities add on independent tensor products. For any coherent tree with W=S0\Q(Pi), I(W;Pi)<=I(S0;Pi)+H(Q|S0), and a fixed final query set restores root-Markov compatibility. This refutes only the exploratory application of an unchanged removed-influence root-compatible conversion bound to actual descendant witnesses; it does not refute A047 v1 or FEI.
